game_start.intro: The game begins. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump card: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in German Whist.
{phase_info}
You hold {hand_size} cards.
Play a card with '[play N]', where N is its position in your hand (for example '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: ĨSOMO YA KŨMANYĨASYA: Mũndũ ũla ũkasinda akakwata kaati yĩ na ĩsyĩtwa yake (face-up) na mũndũ ũla ũkaema kũkwata akosa ĩla ĩngĩ ĩatĩĩe. O tondũ twoona, maũndũ ala meanĩw'a ĩvindanĩ yĩĩ ti ma vata mũno nĩ kana tũsinde mũisyo ũsu.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Vai kaati ya kũthaũka ĩũngamĩwe nĩ mũndũ. No nginya ala mekũkita methĩwe me aĩkĩĩku na mayĩthĩwa maĩlĩte kũtaĩwa.
next_card.deck_empty: Ĩsandũkũ yĩu yĩthĩawa yusĩe mavali na yĩĩla ĩveny'e vaasa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ĩtambya ĩte ya w'o. Tũmĩa "[play N]" kũthaũka kaati ĩla yĩ nthũnĩ yaku.
invalid_move.bad_position: That card position does not exist. You hold {hand_size} cards.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: You must follow suit and play a {lead_suit} card.

trick.won_learning: Mchezaji {winner_id} anashinda mchezo huu na {card} na kuchukua kadi iliyo wazi.

phase.learning_complete: Kĩla kĩminĩte kũseũvw'a no ũndũ ũmwe na ĩvali yasũngawa. Vai ĩngĩ yĩkaema kwĩkala ta ĩvũĩ!

draw.winner_received: Ũkasya wĩ mũsindi, ũkeethĩwa na ĩkoani ya {card}.
draw.loser_received: Umeshindwa kwenye mchezo huu na kuchora {card} kutoka kwenye sitaha.

turn.scores_learning: Mafanikio yaliyopatikana hadi sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Vai kaati ya kũthaũka ĩthaũ yĩu.

trick_view.empty: No cards played yet this trick.

{observation}
Mchezaji {player_id}: {scoring} alipata mafanikio (〕{tricks} jumla), {hand_size} kadi katika mkono

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
